request.title: How should the data-audit service be priced?
request.why: Pricing a service is a commitment to customers and sets the business model.
request.context: Two prospects asked for a one-off data audit. Delivery takes about 3 days.
request.rec_reason: Buyers compare fixed packages more easily, and scope is predictable.

response.note: Neither. I don't want one-off audits. Offer it as a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum; the audit is month one. Rewrite the offer and bring it back.
